last.verdict: Growth slowed again and weak Q4 guidance disappointed, so shares fell.

reasons.label: Weak holiday outlook
reasons.text: Q4 revenue guided to $1.425–1.475B, only 8–12% growth, down from 12% in Q3.

reasons.label: Missed own forecast
reasons.text: Q3 revenue was $1.174B, up 12%, below the $1.19–1.21B range given in August.

reasons.label: Ad revenue per user
reasons.text: Revenue per user rose just 1%; Europe fell 7% despite record 661M users.

story: Growth has cooled from 18% in Q2 to 12% in Q3, and the Q4 forecast points to 8–12%. Revenue came in under the company's own August forecast. Shares have now fallen after back-to-back reports, with ad competition a recurring worry.

history.verdict: Beat on sales and profit, but weaker Q3 outlook sent shares lower.

reasons.label: Slower growth ahead
reasons.text: Q3 revenue guided to $1.19–1.21B, only 13–15% growth versus 18% in Q2.

reasons.label: One-time Q2 boosts
reasons.text: Amazon's Prime Day shifted into Q2 and World Cup ad spending won't repeat in Q3.

reasons.label: Ad competition worries
reasons.text: Investors fretted over rivals Instagram and Reddit, plus weakness in Europe and rising GPU costs.
